children: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:HDFCBANK) has slid about 31% YTD to a 52‑week low amid leadership churn, an ongoing probe into leaks and recent disciplinary action, while merger‑led loan growth, rising funding costs and mixed deposit trends put earnings and returns under scrutiny.
Previous Week Recap
HDFCBANK 52-Week Low
: HDFCBANK hit a 52-week low ₹669.20 on Oct 28, 2026, traded ~₹682–₹687.90; intraday buys 75.55%, deliverable 60.40% of volume, YTD down ~31%, P/E 13.20, market cap ≈ ₹10.56T
HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR CEO
: Anup Bagchi became HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (HDFCBANK) CEO on Oct 27, 2026. Traders note governance scrutiny after the HDFC merger and focus on earnings, loans, deposits and returns.
Loan Book Surges, CASA Declines
: HDFCBANK's loan book surged after the merger; credit-to-deposit ratio hit ~110% and stays high. CASA share fell, raising funding costs and reliance on pricier funding unless deposits rise.
Q3 Deposit Growth 18.8%
: HDFCBANK reported 18.8% YoY deposit growth in Q3; about 4 percentage points came from RBI’s special FCNR(B) inflows. Excluding FCNR(B), domestic deposit growth was roughly 14.8%.
MSRDC Action Disciplinary Warning
: HDFCBANK disclosed July 27 it faced disciplinary action over MSRDC arrangements, citing possible deviation from Reserve Bank of India rules and resulting warnings and monetary penalties.
September Card Spending Rise
: HDFCBANK: September credit card spending rose 7.52% YoY to Rs65,139.72 crore and 6.22% MoM. HDFC’s share of industry spending climbed to ~32%, highest among top issuers.
Corporate Advances Growth
: HDFCBANK reported corporate and wholesale advances grew year‑on‑year in the September quarter, driven by stronger corporate lending amid higher working‑capital needs and supply‑chain disruptions.
NPA: Gross 1.11%
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) Q2 FY27: gross NPA 1.11%, net NPA 0.37%. Bank pursuing growth and higher returns while maintaining credit standards.
Confidential Info Leaks Probe
: HDFCBANK probe into alleged confidential info leaks by two senior execs remains open, fueling leadership uncertainty; no resolution or discipline reported.
Leadership Shifts Ahead
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) faces leadership shifts: Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha exits Dec 31, 2026; former CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan left Oct 26, 2026. Dates public, affect executive lineup.
